def ledger(ops: list[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, int], list[int]]:
    balances = {}
    frozen = set()
    history = []
    rejected = []

    def amount(token):
        if not token.isdigit():
            return None
        return int(token)

    for index, operation in enumerate(ops):
        parts = operation.split(" ")
        success = False

        if parts == ["undo"]:
            if history:
                kind, data = history.pop()

                if kind == "open":
                    balances.pop(data)
                    frozen.discard(data)
                elif kind == "deposit":
                    account, value = data
                    balances[account] -= value
                elif kind == "withdraw":
                    account, value = data
                    balances[account] += value
                elif kind == "transfer":
                    source, destination, value = data
                    balances[source] += value
                    balances[destination] -= value
                elif kind == "freeze":
                    frozen.discard(data)
                else:  # unfreeze
                    frozen.add(data)

                success = True

        elif len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "open":
            _, account, token = parts
            value = amount(token)
            if value is not None and account not in balances:
                balances[account] = value
                history.append(("open", account))
                success = True

        elif len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "deposit":
            _, account, token = parts
            value = amount(token)
            if value is not None and value > 0 and account in balances:
                balances[account] += value
                history.append(("deposit", (account, value)))
                success = True

        elif len(parts) == 3 and parts[0] == "withdraw":
            _, account, token = parts
            value = amount(token)
            if (value is not None and value > 0 and account in balances
                    and account not in frozen and balances[account] >= value):
                balances[account] -= value
                history.append(("withdraw", (account, value)))
                success = True

        elif len(parts) == 4 and parts[0] == "transfer":
            _, source, destination, token = parts
            value = amount(token)
            if (value is not None and value > 0 and source != destination
                    and source in balances and destination in balances
                    and source not in frozen and balances[source] >= value):
                balances[source] -= value
                balances[destination] += value
                history.append(("transfer", (source, destination, value)))
                success = True

        elif len(parts) == 2 and parts[0] == "freeze":
            account = parts[1]
            if account in balances and account not in frozen:
                frozen.add(account)
                history.append(("freeze", account))
                success = True

        elif len(parts) == 2 and parts[0] == "unfreeze":
            account = parts[1]
            if account in balances and account in frozen:
                frozen.remove(account)
                history.append(("unfreeze", account))
                success = True

        if not success:
            rejected.append(index)

    return balances, rejected
